8.33. iLock_Geography.predicate_library.signal¶

The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to signals.

Classes

EndSignal([argOrder, facing]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path, signal)’ if ‘path’ of type PATH has ‘signal’ of type SIGNAL_TYPE as its end signal.
ExitSignal(signalUserTypes[, argOrder]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(signal)’ for each exit signal of SIGNAL_TYPE in the railyard.
LineBegins(signalUserTypes[, argOrder]) Deprecated.
StartSignal([argOrder, facing]) Predicate class that builds true point ‘(path, signal)’ if ‘path’ of type PATH has ‘signal’ of type SIGNAL_TYPE as its start signal.
